_readme: Frozen prompt set for measuring whether AI assistants mention Makecepeit.
DO NOT EDIT THE PROMPTS. Week-to-week numbers are only comparable if the set,
the competitor list and the locale stay identical. If the set genuinely needs
to change, create v2 alongside this file and keep running v1 until v2 has
enough history to stand on its own — otherwise a change in the questions
looks exactly like a change in visibility.
Record each run as seo-audit/geo-ai-visibility-<date>.json using the shape in
'record_shape' below. One run is a reading, not a baseline; the second run is
what makes the first one mean anything.

locale.note: Frozen. Results differ materially by locale, so a change here invalidates the trend.

record_shape._note: One object per (prompt x surface) per run.
record_shape.mentioned: true | false — did the answer name Makecepeit at all
record_shape.position: 1-based rank among tools named, or null if not mentioned
record_shape.linked: true | false — did it link makecepeit.com, not just name it
sources_cited: third-party domains the engine cited, e.g. reddit.com — this is the list that tells us WHERE to earn mentions next

kpis: mention_rate = mentioned / total prompts, per surface
link_rate = linked / mentioned — being named without a link sends no traffic
share_of_voice = times Makecepeit named / times any tool named
branded GSC impressions for 'makecepeit' — the cheapest independent check that AI exposure is turning into demand
